description: Shape of the generated docs/components/registry.json. Interpreted by the minimal validator in scripts/generate-component-registry.mjs, which supports only: type, required, properties, items, enum, additionalProperties. See docs/foundations/component-registry-governance.json for the threshold at which a real JSON Schema library would become warranted.

tier.description: Compositional complexity, derived from the component's folder. Independent of category - see classification in component-registry-governance.json.

category.description: Functional / documentation grouping, authored in contract.json. This enum is the single authoritative list of valid categories: other files may attach definitions, labels, or ordering to these values but must not redefine the set. Independent of tier - see classification in component-registry-governance.json.

status.description: How ready the component is, authored in contract.json. This enum is the single authoritative list of statuses; their meaning and the evidence each needs are in componentStatus in component-registry-governance.json.

knownIssues.description: Unresolved bugs, gaps, and open decisions about this component, authored in contract.json. Any hold it below Stable.

replacedBy.description: For a deprecated component, the id of the one to use instead; null otherwise.

statusCheck.description: Generated: the status the evidence supports, the evidence, and which of Stable's criteria it doesn't meet. component-status.test.ts checks it against the source tree.

figmaSource.description: Passthrough, not schema-enforced - deliberately supports several shapes (single node, multi-variant-node, sub-component, or a documented no-node exception). See docs/foundations/design-code-mapping-governance.json. Nullable for components with no Figma mapping recorded yet.
